# Des Moines Insider

> A local guide to events, restaurants, attractions and family outings in Des Moines, Iowa and its suburbs.

As of 2026-10-01 the site lists 317 upcoming events, 457 restaurants, 22 attractions, 48 playgrounds and 12 local articles. These counts are generated from the database on every build.

Coverage: Des Moines, West Des Moines, Ankeny, Urbandale, Johnston, Clive, Waukee, Altoona and Windsor Heights. Times are Central (America/Chicago). Events are collected daily and reach the published pages on the next site build; restaurant listings are reviewed weekly and attractions monthly.

## Events
- [All events](https://desmoinesinsider.com/events): every upcoming event, filterable by date and category
- [Today](https://desmoinesinsider.com/events/today): events happening today
- [This weekend](https://desmoinesinsider.com/events/this-weekend): Friday through Sunday
- [Free events](https://desmoinesinsider.com/events/free): no-cost events
- [Kids events](https://desmoinesinsider.com/events/kids): family and children's events
- [Date night](https://desmoinesinsider.com/events/date-night): evening events suited to a night out
- [Live music](https://desmoinesinsider.com/music): tonight's shows, this weekend's concerts and the venues that host them
- [Sports](https://desmoinesinsider.com/sports): Iowa Cubs, Iowa Wild, Iowa Wolves and Iowa Barnstormers games, with schedules and venues
- [Iowa State Fair](https://desmoinesinsider.com/iowa-state-fair): dates, parking, hotels and restaurants near the fairgrounds
- Events by suburb: https://desmoinesinsider.com/events/<suburb>, e.g. west-des-moines, ankeny, urbandale, johnston, clive, waukee, altoona, windsor-heights
- [October 2026 events](https://desmoinesinsider.com/events/october-2026): events in Des Moines in October 2026
- [November 2026 events](https://desmoinesinsider.com/events/november-2026): events in Des Moines in November 2026
- [December 2026 events](https://desmoinesinsider.com/events/december-2026): events in Des Moines in December 2026
- [January 2027 events](https://desmoinesinsider.com/events/january-2027): events in Des Moines in January 2027

## Places
- [Restaurants](https://desmoinesinsider.com/restaurants): restaurant directory with cuisine, price and hours
- [Open now](https://desmoinesinsider.com/restaurants/open-now): restaurants open at this moment
- [New restaurants](https://desmoinesinsider.com/restaurants/new): restaurants opened in the last 12 months, plus announced and opening-soon ones
- [Dietary](https://desmoinesinsider.com/restaurants/dietary): restaurants whose listing mentions vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, keto, halal or kosher (a keyword match, not a menu check)
- [What's new](https://desmoinesinsider.com/whats-new): restaurant openings, closings and other changes, newest first
- [Deals](https://desmoinesinsider.com/deals): happy hours, specials and coupons, with the days and times they run
- [Breweries](https://desmoinesinsider.com/breweries): craft breweries and taprooms with their listed hours
- [Best of](https://desmoinesinsider.com/best-of): community-voted best pizza, coffee, brunch and more
- [Attractions](https://desmoinesinsider.com/attractions): museums, parks and things to do
- [Outdoors](https://desmoinesinsider.com/outdoors): state parks, county parks and rail trails within about 40 minutes of downtown
- [Playgrounds](https://desmoinesinsider.com/playgrounds): playgrounds and parks for kids
- [Neighborhoods](https://desmoinesinsider.com/neighborhoods): neighborhood and suburb guides

## Visiting
- [Things to do](https://desmoinesinsider.com/things-to-do): things to do by neighborhood, activity or occasion
- [Visitors guide](https://desmoinesinsider.com/visitors-guide): what's on this weekend, where to eat, stay and how to get around
- [Where to stay](https://desmoinesinsider.com/stay): hotels by area and by distance to a venue
- [Getting around](https://desmoinesinsider.com/getting-around): downtown parking, the skywalk, DART, BCycle, the airport and rideshare
- [Itineraries](https://desmoinesinsider.com/itineraries): curated day and weekend trip plans
- [Group travel](https://desmoinesinsider.com/group-travel): meeting, conference and wedding venues by capacity and type

## Reading
- [Articles](https://desmoinesinsider.com/articles): local articles, including the weekly "This Weekend in Des Moines"
- [Guides](https://desmoinesinsider.com/guides): longer guides to living in and visiting Des Moines
- [About](https://desmoinesinsider.com/about): who runs the site and how listings are collected

## Feeds
- [Sitemap index](https://desmoinesinsider.com/sitemap.xml)
- [RSS](https://desmoinesinsider.com/rss.xml): new articles and upcoming events
- [Calendar feed, all events](https://desmoinesinsider.com/calendar/all.ics): iCalendar, next 60 days, refreshed hourly
- [Calendar feed, free events](https://desmoinesinsider.com/calendar/free.ics): iCalendar, events listed as free
- Per-category calendar feeds: https://desmoinesinsider.com/calendar/<category>.ics, e.g. music, sports, arts, family, food
